en: I need to pee.
Another wave, hold the line!

I can't find my pet frog, Jubjub.  She loves Dark Iron Ale, it's all she ever drinks, but can be so hard to get!  Now I'm out... and Jubjub must have run away to find more!$B$BI wish she would come back...
Hi!  I'm Luis!  What do you think of me so far...?
Honored.
%s begins to cast a spell as you take the cloak from him.
I don't have time to babysit! Go talk to me assistant, Uthrar!
NOW, STAGHELM! WE GO NOW! Prepare your magic!
Sadly, even this must be cut short... The ties that bind me to this world weaken, and pull me away...
%s senses your presence and opens a nether portal!

Oh yes, how wonderful! I have been expecting an emissary from your people, and I am very happy to make your acquaintance.

I do wish I could receive you in our home city of Gnomeregan, but our people have recently fallen on hard times and our homeland is, at present, lost to us.

King Bronzebeard is ever a friend to we gnomes however, and has graciously opened his city to us in this difficult time. 

I hope that your adventures on Azeroth treat you well, and I look forward to further opportunities to learn more of your people. 

Farewell, $N.
Your callous disregard for the sovereign might of the Gurubashi Empire has been noted. The inhabitants of Zul'Gurub have been alerted to your presence.
FOOL! Do you purport to have even one-tenth of the power you held during the Uprising? The nations were united and still were nearly consumed by a shadow of Hakkar. You stand no chance.

To learn to be one with Nature in the eyes of the Earth Mother, this is a matter of pride.  If your will is to learn the ways of the Hunter you must seek out Yaw Sharpmane at the north end of Bloodhoof Village.
We made it, my friend. Remember to find Terenthis and let him know we're safe. Thank you again.
I lost my Crystal Pylon User's Manual and need another one.
Well met, friend!
Let's find out the whole story.  That's going to take some magic...
Fight!  Fight for Darrowshire!
You've put in your time studying the basics. Now it's time to up the ante.
Should I live through this, I shall make it my life's sole ambition to destroy Arthas...
Stormwind is the pillar of the $r race, maintained through strength of will and the edge of a sturdy blade.
Here is your fortune, $N.  May it serve you well.

What am I doing?  Do you lack vision?  I am a dreamer, good $g sir : lady;, and I dream of a better future for us all.  Clearly, I am a visionary.$B$BThere are those, however, who seek to keep us mired in banality.  I told him that I was a dreamer, and Arch Druid Staghelm replied, "Well, the world needs ditch diggers too."$B$BUntil such time as the shackles of banality are ripped from us, I will help the Cenarion Circle by shuffling these piles of dirt around.
The boar is superb!

I guess someone needs to bandage us warriors up after the fighting.  Seek out Arnok at the Survival of the Fittest hut next to the Spirit Lodge in the Valley of Spirits.  Look up above and to the west of the Valley of Strength for a lake.  That's where he's at.
I heard that a noble among the water elementals, Hydraxis, wages war with the servants of fire.  Let's hope he loses!

Dun Baldar is the strongest point of Alliance power in Alterac Valley.  Nestled in the northern reaches of the valley, Dun Baldar is the staging ground for all advances to the south.$B$BDun Baldar is intact.
How many herbs have the Alliance collected so far?
There... that should help. Now, tell me what's happened, Grimclaw.
The Dun Baldar North Bunker was taken by the Alliance!
capture point Win1

The Alliance has taken the lumber mill!
And I don't know anything about this fire of yours...
%s protects himself with magic.
$n, Champion of the Bronze Dragonflight, has rung the Scarab Gong. The ancient gates of Ahn'Qiraj open, revealing the horrors of a forgotten war...

Ah, $c, good to see you. We need assistance here with gathering supplies in preparation for the impending war at Ahn'Qiraj. I've been asked to put together a great many first aid field kits, and the primary component I need is wool bandages. I already have some, $2079w to be exact, but I need to collect $2080w.
Hello, $n. If you'd like to learn a thing or two about cooking, please visit me at any time.
I join you in celebration of this most revered of nights - the night we Forsaken broke the Scourge's yoke of oppression!
